summary: Iter146 usage-analytics — full backend + frontend regression. 22/22 backend tests passed. Admin analytics dashboard renders correctly with KPIs/chips/portals/top-routes; window selector, refresh, sidebar entry, graceful failure on bad payload, and mobile responsiveness all verified.
critical_code_review_comments: p95_ms field is currently computed as $max in routes aggregation pipeline — this is the route worst latency, not a true p95. UI labels it 'Worst ms', which matches what's stored, but the JSON field name `p95_ms` is misleading. Consider renaming to `max_ms` or implementing a real percentile (e.g. via $percentile when on Mongo 7+).

ALLOWED_KINDS validation in TrackEvent only happens server-side after Pydantic parsing — a payload {events: [{kind: 'page_view', portal: '<long unbounded string>'}]} is truncated to 24 chars (good), but the model has no max-length validators at the schema level. Acceptable as graceful (no 422) but worth Field(max_length=...) for defense-in-depth.

Aggregation pipelines iterate the full window with $match on `at`. The {kind,at} index supports the by-kind query but the routes aggregation $match is {at, route ne '', kind='api_call'} — would benefit from a compound index {kind, at} ordered to use the existing one; currently OK but watch growth at 90d × prod traffic.

`_strip_query` UUID detection treats any path segment of length ≥8 made up of [0-9a-f-] as `:id`. Works for UUIDs and hex hashes; a legitimate route segment like '/api/orders/abcdef12' would also be collapsed. Acceptable tradeoff for privacy bucketing.

AdminAnalytics swallows all fetch errors silently (catch{}) — friendly for fire-and-forget but if all 4 endpoints 500, the page renders blank with 'No events in window' which is indistinguishable from real empty data. Consider a small inline error chip when summary fetch fails.
test_credentials: Super Admin jaymn.judd@mascigc.com / Maddix123! works via /api/auth/multi-login. HR creds in the review request (hrmanager@mascigc.com / HRTesting2026!) DO NOT work against /api/auth/multi-login (returns 'Invalid email or password.') but DO work against /api/hr/login. Updated the hr_token fixture accordingly. Main agent may want to verify whether HR users are intended to authenticate via multi-login.
seed_data_creation: Tests post a handful of synthetic page_view / form_submit / export events (route prefixed with /seed/iter146 and /test/iter146) plus traffic to /api/banners/active and a synthetic UUID-bearing /api/master-lookup/equipment/<uuid>/where-used. TTL 90d auto-expires them.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_usage_analytics_iter146.py is reusable; covers public ingest validation, admin gate (rejects bogus token, no auth, HR token), aggregation shape & UUID-bucketing, middleware capture, TTL+dimension indexes, and a coarse latency spot-check. NB: conftest.py auto-injects X-Admin-Token for ALL requests to the backend host, so any future 'unauthenticated' test must either explicitly pass an invalid X-Admin-Token (setdefault won't overwrite) or use urllib directly to bypass the patch.
verified_behaviors: POST /api/usage/track accepts batch, returns {ok:true, queued:N}; bogus kinds silently dropped (no 4xx); empty events list returns 200; events>50 capped at 50; label truncated to 48 chars server-side; no auth required.
Bad payload (events as string) → 422 from Pydantic, never 500.
Middleware writes api_call events: /api/banners/active appears in /admin/analytics/routes within ~3s with count>=3.
Admin gate is real: invalid X-Admin-Token and no-auth both return 401; HR token via X-HR-Token returns 401 ('Admin or PM login required').
TTL index on usage_events.at with expireAfterSeconds=7776000 confirmed via index_information(). Compound indexes (kind, at) (portal, at) (route, at) all present.
UUID-bearing path /api/master-lookup/equipment/<uuid>/where-used collapses to /api/master-lookup/equipment/:id/where-used in the routes bucket — raw UUID never leaks.
Portal breakdown correctly buckets admin (X-Admin-Token), anon (no headers), and others. Verified 'admin' bucket present with >100 events.

Frontend /admin/analytics loads under super admin; 4 KPI cards render with correct testids; by-kind chips for api_call/page_view/form_submit/export; by-viewport desktop chip; by-portal admin tile; top-routes table has 20 rows.
Window selector (data-testid='analytics-window-select') changes data: 24h Events=390 → 7d Events=397; triggered 4 endpoint refetches.
Refresh button (data-testid='analytics-refresh') re-fetches all 4 endpoints: summary, routes, portals, health.
Sidebar nav contains 'Usage Analytics' link via AdminShell.
Graceful failure: POST /api/usage/track with events=[] returns 200 {ok:true,queued:0} — does NOT break parent page.
Mobile 390x844: body.scrollWidth == window.innerWidth (390/390), no horizontal overflow; KPIs stack 2x2 via Tailwind sm:grid-cols-4.
